correction: Eventual failure does not negate earlier recorded landing/riding. Descriptive intervals do not establish new-task success. Original labels and raw records are unchanged.

audit.descriptor: post-Apex; abs(front/rear terrain clearance)<=0.01m; abs roll<=5deg; abs pitch<=10deg; vx>=1m/s
audit.window_duration: last timestamp minus first timestamp, not frame_count*dt
audit.claim_boundary: Descriptive recorded landing/riding intervals, not a new full-task success adjudication. New tracking_values_only excludes contact/collision and event-chain evidence, so it cannot qualify task success.
audit.tracking_scope: Post-Apex numerical recovery thresholds only, sampled at control endpoints; excludes terrain descriptor, contacts, collision and new event chain. No passing 0.5s numerical hold occurs in these old traces; this is not a new-scene evaluation.

checkpoint_integrity.scope: Identity, payload hash and parameter restore; one deterministic 76D zero-observation inference. No new physics, no fresh performance evaluation.

independent_review_scope: A second agent independently verified earlier-policy 8 NPZ hashes, descriptor durations and recovery numerical holds. This is data review, not simulator replay.
